server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-auth.ts.name: ChatGPT plan OAuth
server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-auth.ts.description: Runs loopback OAuth with PKCE against auth.openai.com, stores and rotates tokens under a file lock, and revokes on sign-out.

server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-auth.test.ts.name: ChatGPT OAuth tests
server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-auth.test.ts.description: Exercises the OAuth controller against a fake issuer: PKCE, JWKS identity checks, refresh locking, revocation and refused models.

server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-token-bridge.name: Plan token bridge
server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-token-bridge.description: Serves the current ChatGPT access token to one Codex run over a secret-guarded local socket or named pipe.

server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-token-comman.name: Plan token command
server/drivers/chatgpt-plan-token-comman.description: Reads the access token from the local bridge and prints it to stdout when Codex invokes its auth.command.

server/drivers/codex-plan-token.ts.name: Codex plan args
server/drivers/codex-plan-token.ts.description: Builds Codex -c overrides for the Responses-API plan provider and starts the token bridge when Codex can renew.

server/drivers/codex-account-home.ts.name: Codex account homes
server/drivers/codex-account-home.ts.description: Maps a ChatGPT account to its own Codex home and decides when it signs in by device code.

server/drivers/codex-device-auth.ts.name: Codex device sign-in
server/drivers/codex-device-auth.ts.description: Specifies the codex login --device-auth flow, status check, logout and safe failure messages for the device controller.

server/drivers/codex-login.ts.name: Codex login status
server/drivers/codex-login.ts.description: Reads Codex auth.json and codex login status to tell signed-in, signed-out or API-key logins apart.

server/drivers/device-auth.ts.name: Device auth controller
server/drivers/device-auth.ts.description: Drives a CLI device-code login as a child process, parses the page and code, and confirms sign-in before success.

server/drivers/claude-login-auth.ts.name: Claude CLI sign-in
server/drivers/claude-login-auth.ts.description: Drives the unmodified claude auth login with pipes, shows only Anthropic's link, and pipes the pasted code to stdin.

server/drivers/claude-auth-status.ts.name: Claude auth status
server/drivers/claude-auth-status.ts.description: Parses claude auth status --json into signed-in state, email, organization and API-key method.

server/drivers/claude-auth-recovery.ts.name: Claude refusal recovery
server/drivers/claude-auth-recovery.ts.description: Holds a turn's events until first model activity so a signed-out or usage-limit refusal rejects the turn cleanly.

server/drivers/claude-limits.ts.name: Claude limit parsing
server/drivers/claude-limits.ts.description: Reads Claude Code rate_limit_info and api-error frames into usage-limit scope, reset time and user-facing messages.

server/drivers/openai-responses.ts.name: OpenAI Responses routing
server/drivers/openai-responses.ts.description: Translates chat messages to the Responses API and moves a model from chat to responses when tools are refused.

server/drivers/codex-config-provider.ts.name: Codex provider overrides
server/drivers/codex-config-provider.ts.description: Copies a config.toml model provider into -c overrides, moving bearer tokens and headers into the child environment.

shared/device-sign-in.ts.name: Device sign-in rules
shared/device-sign-in.ts.description: Defines per-provider allow-lists for sign-in pages and code formats, and extracts the newest page and code from CLI output.

server/provider-key-check.ts.name: Provider key check
server/provider-key-check.ts.description: Validates an API key with a GET to the provider's models endpoint over https and classifies the verdict.

server/key-hint.ts.name: Key hints
server/key-hint.ts.description: Reports whether a secret is set and exposes only its last four characters to admins.

server/key-rejections.ts.name: Rejected key memory
server/key-rejections.ts.description: Remembers provider-rejected keys by URL and hash and decides which HTTP failures mean a bad key.

server/anthropic-key-env.ts.name: Anthropic key env
server/anthropic-key-env.ts.description: Turns the saved Anthropic key and URL into ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL for a Claude instance.

server/credential-env.ts.name: Credential env lists
server/credential-env.ts.description: Lists the provider and workspace credential env names stripped from spawned engine processes.

server/sign-in-env.ts.name: Sign-in email lists
server/sign-in-env.ts.description: Reads admin and member sign-in email lists from environment variables and refuses conflicting Settings edits.

server/provider-auth-sessions.ts.name: Auth flow sessions
server/provider-auth-sessions.ts.description: Binds each in-progress provider sign-in to the admin session that started it, with expiry, busy and revoke handling.

server/routes/instances.ts.name: Instance routes
server/routes/instances.ts.description: Handles instance HTTP routes including ChatGPT account creation and auth start, status, complete, cancel and sign-out.

server/routes/cli-login.ts.name: Terminal login pairing
server/routes/cli-login.ts.description: Lets a terminal request a session that a person approves in the app, matched by a shown code and PKCE-style verifier.

server/plan-usage.ts.name: Plan usage reader
server/plan-usage.ts.description: Reads Claude and Codex CLI credentials and queries their usage endpoints to build five-hour and weekly limit windows.

server/claude-endpoints.ts.name: Claude custom endpoints
server/claude-endpoints.ts.description: Builds Claude instances that point at another base URL with a saved token and model tiers via ANTHROPIC env vars.

server/engine-homes/sign-ins.ts.name: Engine sign-in sync
server/engine-homes/sign-ins.ts.description: Copies engine credential files between the team file and each audience home, taking back the newest refreshed copy.

server/engine-homes/layout.ts.name: Engine home layout
server/engine-homes/layout.ts.description: Defines per-audience engine homes and which credential files (.credentials.json, auth.json) are shared.

shared/engine-sign-in.ts.name: Key-only engine check
shared/engine-sign-in.ts.description: Decides whether an engine card offers only an API key, so server and Settings agree.

server/config.ts.name: App config store
server/config.ts.description: Holds the config schema including provider API keys and writes config.json atomically with mode 0600.

server/drivers/codex.ts.name: Codex driver
server/drivers/codex.ts.description: Spawns Codex per account and wires the ChatGPT plan auth controller, token bridge and device login into its instance.

server/drivers/openai-chat.ts.name: OpenAI chat client
server/drivers/openai-chat.ts.description: Sends Chat Completions or Responses requests with a bearer key and lists models for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

server/drivers/claude.ts.name: Claude driver
server/drivers/claude.ts.description: Spawns Claude Code, strips inherited API keys, and wires the CLI login controller and auth status into its instance.

src/components/ClaudeSignIn.tsx.name: Claude sign-in UI
src/components/ClaudeSignIn.tsx.description: Shows Anthropic's sign-in link and a paste box for the code, then calls the instance auth routes.

src/components/DeviceSignIn.tsx.name: Device sign-in UI
src/components/DeviceSignIn.tsx.description: Renders the Codex device code or ChatGPT browser flow, opens the OpenAI link and polls the flow status.

src/components/ChatGptPlanStatus.tsx.name: ChatGPT plan status
src/components/ChatGptPlanStatus.tsx.description: Shows the using-ChatGPT-plan line, usage link and a first-time welcome dialog.

src/components/keys/key-catalog.ts.name: API key catalog
src/components/keys/key-catalog.ts.description: Lists each provider key row with env name, placeholder, console link, shape check and test target.
